info.name: FU News - Module 1 API
info.description:
Bo kiem thu API cua FU News, Module 1: Editorial Workflow & Approval Management.

Xac thuc bang JWT Bearer, khong con cookie phien. Bo nay chay TUAN TU tu tren xuong: cac request dau luu token va id vao bien collection cho cac request sau dung.

Chay bang Newman: npx --yes newman run postman/FUNews.postman_collection.json

Can backend dang chay o localhost:8080 va database da chay database/module1_schema.sql.
